Elastic Cloud — managing deployments

elastic/organization · version 1

envs add elastic/organization

This declares the keys below in your catalog and sets none of them. A template is a schema for keys; it never carries a value.

Key Needed Kind Notes
EC_API_KEY required secret Manages Cloud deployments, not their data, and is the one documented variable name in Elastic's family. Keep it apart from the deployment credentials: this one can delete what those read. Revoke and create anew; there is no rotation in place.. where to get it
